description: This file defines encoder functions and mappings used for serializing various Python and Pydantic data types into JSON-compatible formats within the FastAPI framework. It includes custom encoders for types like Decimal, datetime, UUID, IP addresses, and Pydantic models, along with a comprehensive jsonable_encoder function that handles complex serialization scenarios.

methods.name: str isoformat(o: Union[datetime.date, datetime.time])
methods.description: Converts a date or time object to its ISO 8601 string representation, taken from Pydantic v1.

methods.name: Union[int,float] decimal_encoder(dec_value: Decimal)
methods.description: Encodes a Decimal as an integer if there are no significant exponents; otherwise as float, for JSON serialization.

methods.name: dict[Callable[[Any],Any],tuple[Any,...]] generate_encoders_by_class_tuples( type_encoder_map: dict[Any, Callable[[Any], Any]], )
methods.description: Creates a mapping from encoder functions to tuples of classes/types they handle.

methods.description: Main function that serializes complex Python objects into JSON-compatible formats, handling Pydantic models, dataclasses, enums, built-in types, collections, and custom encoders.
